title: •Meditation
caption: •Meditation (V)
game_text: Use 2 Force to deploy on table. Once per game, may use 1 Force to play an Interrupt (except Sense, Alter, or Control) from under your Starting Effect as if from hand (then place that card out of play). May place this Effect in Lost Pile to activate 1 Force.
lore: To prepare for the inevitable conflict with Jabba’s minions, Luke entered a calm state of mental preparation.
